# Public OpenMed exceptions that are not rooted under OpenMedError yet.
#
# This list only shrinks. Root a class with openmed.core.errors.LegacyRootedError
# and delete its line; `python scripts/release/check_error_roots.py --prune`
# removes every entry the scan proves stale. Never add a line: a new public
# exception must be rooted instead. See docs/api/errors.md ("Rerooting legacy
# exceptions"). One sorted `module:QualName` per line.
